metadata.title: ScrapTrace
metadata.description: Safe e-waste recovery, from first record to reviewed outcome.

public.title: Track e-waste with a clear chain of evidence
public.description: ScrapTrace connects safe identification, approved guidance and recovery records without overstating what a photo can prove.

pages.collectorDescription: Start a record, revisit saved work or find a suitable receiving location.
pages.captureDescription: Camera capture and uploads will be implemented in the collector journey milestone.
pages.recordsDescription: Record lists and journey details will be implemented in a later milestone.
pages.locationsDescription: Location search will use the typed location service boundary.
pages.profileDescription: Account, language and local-data controls will be added with authentication.
pages.recyclerDescription: QR intake, measured weight and evidence workflows are intentionally deferred.
pages.reviewDescription: The review queue will preserve flags as indicators requiring human judgement.
pages.managementDescription: Reporting will include only role-authorised, status-separated totals.
pages.safetyDescription: Approved-card governance will be built against the safety service contract.
pages.mlDescription: Corrections will remain reviewed candidates and will never retrain a model automatically.
pages.signInDescription: Choose a role profile to preview its workspace.
pages.notFoundDescription: The requested page is unavailable or has moved.
pages.errorDescription: Your work has not been discarded. Try the page again.
pages.registerDescription: Registration will be added with authentication in a later milestone.
pages.onboardingDescription: Language and privacy choices will be added in the collector journey milestone.

onboarding.title: ScrapTrace
onboarding.subtitle: Public E-Waste Recovery & Traceability Infrastructure. Choose language to proceed.
onboarding.note: Public recovery networks enforce offline reliability. Local settings cached automatically on confirmation.

privacy.title: Privacy & Data Governance
privacy.subtitle: Public service protocols protect your personal details while verifying ecological outcomes.
privacy.requiredText: Capture photo evidence of recovery state (materials check), record GPS coordinates (trusted audit loop), and preserve device records.
privacy.optionalText: Allow image-based classification models to train on anonymous physical wear & tear profiles to improve automated classification.
privacy.noteText: Camera access requested only when Capture is initiated. Location verification requested only for Nearby and Verified GPS records.

collectorHome.registerText: Capture items securely. (Operational camera and location verification requested upon start.)
collectorHome.privacy: Privacy reminder: ScrapTrace registers material volume only. Avoid capturing faces or PII.

records.safetyText: Always use non-conductive gloves when moving cracked battery packs. Keep sealed.

capture.serialRequired: Enter a serial number or brand name.
capture.safetyText: Always wear protective gloves when moving materials or damaged screens to avoid mercury exposure.
capture.valid: The form is valid. Nothing is saved yet: record creation arrives in the collector journey milestone.

account.clearHint: Permanently removes locally stored recovery records and unsynced drafts from this physical storage drive.

clearCache.title: Confirm Cleared Cache
clearCache.warningText: You are about to delete {records} cached offline recovery records and {drafts} unfinished draft.
clearCache.warningStrong: Server records that have already synchronized will remain intact.
clearCache.failure: Mock Failure: Locked cache thread. Retrying.
clearCache.notAvailable: Nothing was deleted. Local storage arrives in the offline milestone.

recyclerHome.verifyText: Scan a local collector's QR voucher or enter identification code manually to confirm intake receipt.
recyclerHome.batchText: Reported copper volume matches indicative estimates, waiting for manual confirmation.

recyclerIntake.scanText: Present this code to hand over materials or scan a collector's local transfer record.

manager.estimatesText: Estimated weight allocations based on statistical model reference guides. No regulatory or final processing guarantees implied.
manager.verifiedText: Physical measured weights confirmed by disassembly centers and registered directly into the secure ledger of processing outcomes.

safety.mercuryText: Regulatory advisory targeting fluorescent mercury bulb breakage during sorting activities. Ensure immediate non-spark ventilation is active.
safety.leadText: Safe physical handling guidelines of cathode ray tube funnels containing heavy metals. Use protective aprons and thick puncture-resistant gloves.

ml.verifyGps: Verify Image Resolution matches GPS Coordinates
